task.text:
[0] Deletion of gon-1 (ortholog of human ADAMTS20) induced longevity and dauer formation. FUdR (40 μM) was added.

[1] Median lifespan difference was significant p < 0.01. The maximum survival was also significantly different p < 0.02.

[2] Mice, expressing a constitutively active version of ADRA1A, had better cognitive functions and a longer lifespan, compared to wild type.

[3] Mice, expressing a constitutively active version of ADRA1B, had lower body weight at a young age, compared to wild type, but a similar weight in maturity, and shortened lifespan.

[4] Agtr1a –/– mice developed less cardiac and vascular injury, less oxidative damage, increased number of mitochondria, prosurvival genes Nampt and Sirt3 were upregulated in the kidney. Agtr1a –/– mice lifespan was increased (P < 0.0001).

[5] Overexpression of Akt promoted early death in flies. In contrast, downregulation of Akt by RNAi showed no effect on longevity.

[6] Haploinsufficiency of Akt1 prolongs the lifespan of mice (mean p<0.05, max P<0.001). Maximum lifespan was calculated as the average for the oldest 20% of the mice in each group.

[7] Knockdown of akt-1 significantly prolonged the lifespan of worms and resulted in decreased expression of ribosomal genes and reduction of mitochondrial DNA. Nematodes at the L4 stage were transferred to RNAi bacterial plates in the presence of 1 mM isopropyl β-D-thiogalactopyranoside (IPTG), 25 mg/ml carbenicillin and 5-fluoro-20-deoxyuridine (FUdR, 0.5 mg/ml). L1 period as t = 0 for lifespan analysis.

[8] Haploinsufficiency of Akt1 prolongs the lifespan of mice (mean p<0.001, max p<0.001). Maximum lifespan was calculated as the average for the oldest 20% of the mice in each group.

[9] Age was counted from the first day of the adulthood. Worms were threated with 2 mM IPTG during the development. Beginning from the first day of the adulthood, they were transferred in the 0.1 mg/ml FUDR containing media.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
